templates.name: Developer desk
templates.description: An instrument panel: Claude and ChatGPT quota, the status of the services you build on and the machine across the top; a scratchpad, today's tasks, new releases and a 50/10 timer under them. Hacker News, blogs and your links wait on a second page.

templates.name: Buổi sáng
templates.description: A magazine spread for the first coffee: your sky painted as it is now, the lunar date and today's list on the left, a column of lead stories from five papers on the right. A second page has the world, business, gold, Vietcombank rates and this day in history.

templates.name: Market watch
templates.description: The four Vietnamese indices as one band of charts, with blue chips, market news and gold under it. A second page has world indices and crypto as charts, then commodities, big tech and business news.

templates.name: Study desk
templates.description: Only what helps you learn: a big word card, a pomodoro and your study habits with their streaks, then notes, homework and a quiz on the words you have seen, in the soft Mochi skin.

templates.name: Home lab
templates.description: Uptime checks beside CPU and network traces, then releases of the apps you self-host, the status of the cloud you depend on and a runbook, on the green Phosphor terminal skin.

templates.name: Night chill
templates.description: Your sky after dark, painted, and a lo-fi stream on an old wooden TV; tonight's habits, tomorrow's list and a tall journal. No news, no prices.

templates.name: Minimal desk
templates.description: A photo of the day, a clock face and the weather; your list and the lunar month under them. No titles, nothing that scrolls.

templates.name: AI desk
templates.description: Four tall gauges on the Neon skin: Claude and ChatGPT quota left and when it resets, whether Claude, OpenAI and GitHub are up, and how hard the machine is working. AI news, new releases of your tools and your prompts under them.

templates.name: Học tiếng Nhật
templates.description: JLPT N5 words with their Hán Việt reading and Vietnamese meaning: a big word card, a quiz and a timer, and the whole level as a band of tiles under them. On the Aurora skin.

templates.name: Sống khoẻ
templates.description: For days at a desk: your habits with streaks and a heatmap, the air quality outside and the week's weather, a nudge to stand up after 50 minutes, this week's list and a calm photo of the day. On the Ocean skin.

templates.name: Mission control
templates.description: A window on space on the NASA skin: a live view of Earth from orbit on a starship viewscreen, NASA's picture of the day, this day in history, mission time in three zones and the month.

templates.name: Tết & gia đình
templates.description: The family's year by the lunar calendar on the red and gold Tết skin: the month and today's page with the family's own days counted down, this day in history, gold and bank rates, then the Tết shopping list, the tray, and the week's weather.

templates.name: Học tiếng Trung
templates.description: HSK 1 in simplified characters with pinyin, Hán Việt and Vietnamese meanings on the Paper skin: the whole level as a sheet down the left, a big word card, a quiz and your daily practice on the right.

templates.name: Battle station
templates.description: For the gaming PC on the Mecha skin: CPU, memory and disks as live graphs beside a music screen, the network's speed, whether Discord and Reddit are up, gaming news and the time.

templates.name: Crypto
templates.description: The four biggest coins as one band of charts on the Liquid skin, then your altcoins, news from CoinDesk and Cointelegraph, and gold, the dollar and stocks beside them. No API key, no exchange account.

templates.name: Engineering lead
templates.description: For a day of reviews and meetings on the PROJECT skin: meetings down the left with a Join button, pull requests waiting for your review with their checks, your Linear issues, then one-on-one notes, service status and follow-ups. Needs a GitHub token, a Linear key and your calendar's iCal link.

templates.name: Văn phòng
templates.description: A working day on the light Glyx skin: the day's meetings with a Join button for Teams, Meet or Zoom, your Jira issues by status, the time where your partners are, meeting minutes and today's list. Needs your Jira API token and your calendar's iCal link.

templates.name: Nhà thông minh
templates.description: Your home from the desk on the Hextech skin: the sky over your city beside Home Assistant's lights and switches (a tap turns them on or off), the sensors, the air outside, the network and the week's weather. Needs your Home Assistant address and token.

widgets.name: Tech news
widgets.description: Hacker News front page and The Verge in one list.

widgets.name: Tin Việt Nam
widgets.description: VnExpress, Tuổi Trẻ, Thanh Niên and Dân Trí as a grid of cards.

widgets.name: Kinh tế & chứng khoán
widgets.description: Stock market news from CafeF, VnEconomy and Vietstock.

widgets.name: Developer blogs
widgets.description: The GitHub blog, Show HN and Viblo as compact headlines.

widgets.name: Show HN
widgets.description: What people are building, straight from Hacker News.

widgets.name: AI tool releases
widgets.description: New versions of Claude Code, Ollama and llama.cpp, marked until you open them.

widgets.name: World clock
widgets.description: Tokyo, London and New York with their offset from you.

widgets.name: Weather in Saigon
widgets.description: Now, the next 12 hours and 7 days for Ho Chi Minh City.

widgets.name: Crypto
widgets.description: Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana with a price chart.

widgets.name: Ngày lễ Việt Nam
widgets.description: A calendar counting down to the public holidays.

widgets.name: Deep work timer
widgets.description: 50 minutes of focus, 10 of rest. Needs the Pomodoro source.
